count_scope: Only the three main Exa research workstreams. Counts exclude root follow-up searches for Jev and TypeSafe and authoritative search verification. Returned discovery entries are not independent studies or fully read pages. Selected primary URLs are deduplicated after removing a trailing slash.

limitations: No independent-user pilot, outreach, repeat-use measurement, willingness-to-pay data or competitor runtime benchmark was performed.
Only relevant sections were reviewed. MCP SDK source fetches were character-capped at 20,000 characters and deps.dev documentation at 50,000; this is not a full-source review.
The CISA guidance page was retrieved through Exa and authoritative search; a separate direct open returned HTTP 403.
Cached Exa content for cyanheads was superseded by live GitHub source (blob 4b12e7f63ac003b9c6a4695caca47eba35e15686).

Jev was executed separately as an evidence-claim review using supplied summaries. Its request and observed response fields are in jev-evidence-review-2026-10-22.json. It is not counted as a source search or a demand experiment.
MiroFish and a formal Codex Security Cloud audit were not run. Agent workstreams do not imply distinct underlying model providers.
